name: Seated Overhead Rope Cable Extension
description: A seated variation of the overhead cable triceps extension using a rope attachment. Sitting with cable behind ensures constant tension through the long head of the triceps. The rope allows the hands to separate at peak contraction for enhanced muscle activation.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Seated Overhead Rope Cable Extension in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Seated Overhead Rope Cable Extension.
steps: Step 1: Set low cable pulley. Sit facing away from cable with rope overhead.
Step 2: Hold rope behind head with elbows bent and upper arms vertical.
Step 3: Extend elbows to press rope overhead, separating handles at top.
Step 4: Lower slowly back behind head maintaining upper arm position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Spread the rope at the top
